corrections.text: The article quotes the foundation as saying the network "will not use behavioral tracking or third-party tracking." Both the cited Fortune press-release announcement and the Yahoo Finance republication of the same announcement actually state the network "will not use behavioral targeting or third-party tracking."

The article quotes Tobie Langel asking for "regular updates on how this sustainability program is going." The cited GitHub comment verbatim reads "regular updates on how this sustainability programs are going" (plural "programs").
